sentences.text:
---- Applicant  Versus 1 - State Of Chhattisgarh Through The Station House Officer, Police Station Iragoan, District Kondagaon (C.G.)
 ---- Respondent For Applicant : Mr. T.K. Jha with Mr. Tapan Kumar Chandra, Advocates For Respondent : Mr.
Vinay Pandey, Dy.A.G. Hon'ble Shri Justice Parth Prateem Sahu Order On Board 15/07/2024 1.

Applicant has filed this second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No.07 of 2023, registered at Police Station - Iragoan, District - Kondagaon (C.G.) for offence punishable under 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
The first bail application of the applicant was dismissed vide order dated 24.04.2024 in M.Cr.C. No. 2418 of 2024.

2. Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that, Baliram Korram lodged the report in the concerned Police Station stating that he received Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:25609 one message in the Facebook profile that huge amount will be paid against old coins upon which, complainant has posted picture of old coins available with him.

Thereafter, he received Whatsapp message from the specified mobile number mentioned therein that he will get Rs. 53,00,000/- against old coins,
however, he has to forward copy of his Aadhar Card.
Applicant forwarded copy of his Aadhar Card and photographs.
He thereafter received another message to deposit Rs. 750/- through QR code and thereafter on different dates money was demanded.

Complainant in all deposited Rs. 8,53,250/-
online and thereafter he realized that he was cheated.
Based on the report, aforementioned crime was registered and applicant was arrested on 15.02.2024.

Mousam vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50499339/
1 3.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated in the aforementioned crime.
He has not committed any offence.
Applicant is running the agency as Common Service Center and the name of center is Mousam Atal Seva Kendra.
He was asked to get the deposit which is coming in his account and thereafter other persons has withdrawn the amount.
Applicant was running service center under authorization of Punjab National Bank, amount deposited in his account has been paid in cash for which applicant received only commission.
Applicant is in jail since 15.02.2024 hence, he may be enlarged on bail.
Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:25609 4.
Learned State counsel opposes the submission of learned counsel for applicant and would submit that applicant along with others defrauded the complainant through online and received Rs.8,53,250/-.

He also pointed out that during the pendency of investigation, amount has been transferred in the account of Nitin Vishwakarma, Ajeet, Amit and Shubham and the aforementioned persons thereafter transferred the amount in the account of applicant.
Therefore, there is direct involvement of applicant.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.
6. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation and the manner in which the offence is committed, I do not find present to be a fit case for grant of bail.
7. Accordingly, the bail application filed under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. is rejected.

Sd/-
